message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a Wild Draw Four, the next player draws four cards and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). On your turn you must play one card that matches either the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top discard. If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” If you forget and another player catches you before the next player takes a turn, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still in opponents’ hands: number cards = face value, action cards = 20 points, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the agreed‑upon score (commonly 500) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep a mix of colors** – It gives you more options to play. 2. **Save Wild Draw Fours** – Use them when you’re stuck or to block a strong opponent. 3. **Watch the discard pile** – If you see a color you’re low on, you might want to play a Skip or Reverse to keep that color in play. 4. **Challenge wisely** – Only challenge a Wild Draw Four if you’re sure the player had a playable card. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
